profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Frontend | Backend | JavaScript | C++ | Ruby | Rails | React.js | Redux.js | PostgreSQL | Mongoose | MongoDB | HTML 5 | CSS | Sass
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer and I am well-versed in many different languages: JavaScript, C++, and Ruby. In addition to my proficiency in programming languages, I am also fluent in English and Vietnamese. As a full-stack engineer, I have used many frameworks such as React/Redux, PostgreSQL, Ruby on Rails, and MERN and utilized HTML and CSS. I especially enjoyed Sass, which is CSS but better. I'm also passionate about and actively improving my Japanese. I am currently working on a turn-based RPG that allows players to build their own team of unique archetypal characters to overcome different challenges the game has to throw at them. I love creating beautiful and interactive things, which is why I am passionate about software development. 
I love playing video games. My favorite genre is role-playing games(RPG), especially Classic-RPG. My favorite game of all time is Divinity Original Sins 2 Definitive Edition. I hope to one day make something that is as fun, impactful and genre-defining as this game.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

Ubuntu Virtual Machine, etc...
* Conduct technical screens of coding Bootcamp applicants and assess algorithmic aptitude in various
languages, including JavaScript, Ruby, and Python.
